summary:
Published all 18 compatible pipeline packages through existing GitHub Actions workflows: 0.2.0 except Ingestion 0.3.0. Release branches/tags and exact commits/run URLs are in ci-receipts.json; no main merges or production deployment.
API/UI exact pins and lockfiles updated, clean registry npm ci and integrity verification passed (30 installed instances / 25 archives). API/UI full checks, UI build, 137 API tests, 4 UI submission tests and live authenticated revision integration with 28 feedback tests passed.
All 11 application images rebuilt and services restarted; all 11 HTTP health checks returned 200. Running API uses normal ensuredapi-api image without local source overlay. Installed Shared/Normalization/RiskCompute 0.2.0 and Ingestion 0.3.0 verified; CanonicalSubmission export and canonical table absent. Existing data/volumes preserved.
Runtime reader module loads, but no eligible existing saved revision or completed baseline was available for a live-data reader invocation. Separate disposable-database authenticated revision integration passed; this limitation is explicit in runtime.json. Before rollout, live DB already recorded the retirement migration, with no canonical table and 77 feedback versions; cutover was not replayed.
Requested publication/local rebuild scope complete. Existing package-wide static-check gaps remain AIN-206; broader AIN-3/95 and financial tickets remain incomplete. No blanket merge-readiness claim.
